title: Ullathai Allitha
desc: Tired of his father's disciplinarian ways and to avoid marrying a girl chosen by the latter, Raja runs away to Ooty. There, he is hired as a driver by the man whose daughter he was supposed to marry.

title: Kunguma Chimizh
desc: Orphans Ravi and Philomena meet on a bus journey and fall in love, but poverty and unemployment create a barrier between them.

title: Jee
desc: Vasu aspires to contest in the college elections but is forced to let go because of a politician's son. However, when the latter's goons harass him, he vows to stand up for himself.
